details: This package declares a postinstall hook ("node index.js") whose entire payload is a DNS callback: index.js calls dns.lookup() on the per-package hostname ecf9b17e-4d04-499c-ab0b-5d94402c760b.webhook[.]site, so every install resolves an operator-controlled webhook[.]site subdomain and thereby registers that the package was installed. The package contains nothing else of substance — a single unused export that logs "SVG Bucket initialized." — and the callback carries no data: no environment variables, tokens, credential files or file contents are read or transmitted, and no second-stage code is fetched. The advertised functionality (a utility for managing SVG buckets) is not implemented anywhere in the 315-byte index.js. This package declares a postinstall hook ("node index.js") that runs its main entry file at install time. That file's only real action is a DNS callback: index.js calls dns.lookup() on the per-package hostname ecf9b17e-4d04-499c-ab0b-5d94402c760b.webhook[.]site, so installing the package resolves an operator-controlled webhook[.]site subdomain and registers the install. No environment variables, tokens, credential files or file contents are read or transmitted, and no second-stage code is fetched. This package declares a postinstall hook ("node index.js") that, on every install, performs a DNS lookup of the operator-controlled hostname ecf9b17e-4d04-499c-ab0b-5d94402c760b.webhook[.]site, registering the install with a webhook[.]site callback endpoint. No environment variables, tokens, credential files or file contents are transmitted; the lookup carries only the fixed hostname and no second-stage code is fetched.
